release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.27 - Contact Permissions & Stability Update:
- Fixed contact picker permissions for Android 13+ (API 33+) and below
- Added contact picker queries to AndroidManifest for Android 11+ package visibility
- Improved ContactPickerService with comprehensive permission handling for all Android versions
- Enhanced iOS contact permission support with iOS 18+ limited access compatibility
- Better error messages and user feedback for contact permission issues
- Fixed 'Contact selection cancelled or permission denied' error
- Improved contact picker integration in chat screen
- Added detailed logging for debugging contact permission issues
- Enhanced user guidance for permanently denied permissions
- Various stability improvements and bug fixes
